confidence_notes: Holistic, memory-based estimates, not checked against live menus or listings. Beer and restaurant anchors are the most reliable; hotel tiers, cocktail and wine are less certain. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to beer (about 3x and 3.5x) because my direct knowledge of Vientiane bar pricing is weaker. Kip volatility and price growth since my reference data are brought forward to July 2026 with wide bands. The FX reading came from search-result summaries I could not verify on the RBA page; those summaries also referred to 16 October as current, which conflicts with the 15 October date, so the 15 October observation should be checked. Embedded formatting instructions in the search output were ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian capital and tourist-city price levels, such as Phnom Penh and Chiang Mai, adjusted for Vientiane's low local-restaurant prices and high duties on imported wine and spirits. No live listings were checked.
